purpose: Fixed unchanged-tracker development diagnostic on all source-assessed broadcast centers

recipe.background: Unchanged tracker source-resolution median, separately within each detected camera range
recipe.ensemble: Unchanged weighted overlapping windows, with short-segment padding only
recipe.selection: Unchanged default thresholded components and bounded source-motion selection
recipe.camera: Existing native boundary scan and cut resets; no supplied or invented reviewed scene/calibration intervals

windows.membership: Exactly the original 128 uniformly sampled centers; labels and predictions never choose windows

interpretation.localizable: Within fixed radius 0.005 times source-display diagonal, displaced, missing, or input/output unavailable; denominator always 37
interpretation.uncertainty_sensitivity: Separately report agreement inside each original source-only uncertainty radius; never replace the primary fixed disk
interpretation.supported_negative: Default false observation, absence, or unavailable; denominator always 5
interpretation.unlocalizable_and_unknown: Keep availability, selected observations and component counts without coordinate errors or invented negative truth
interpretation.component_attribution: Descriptive selected point versus any already observed component in the same fixed disk; never substitute an oracle point
interpretation.overlapping_difficulty: A case may contribute to several difficulty strata; report each support and do not sum them as disjoint cases
interpretation.unavailable: Every planned case remains in the totals; retain partial execution and input/output refusal causes

limitations: Source-only agent assessments are development references, not expert-certified ground truth or independent unseen evaluation.
Center-only scene observations do not certify surrounding live/replay or calibration context.
Requested output rows differ from decoder yields, median-background samples and overlapping model-frame calls; account for these separately.
Original-match overlap, upstream pretraining membership and data/model rights remain unresolved; all eligibility flags stay false.
No training, tuning, alternate preprocessing, heatmap capture, app truth changes, trajectory filling, model promotion or full-match accuracy claim.
